steps.message: Add the recipes from recipes.txt in Markor to the Broccoli recipe app.
Execute: adb shell "date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S %Z %z'; pm list packages | grep -Ei 'markor|broccoli|recipe'"

arguments.command: python android_env.py adb "adb shell "date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S %Z %z'; pm list packages | grep -Ei 'markor|broccoli|recipe'""

steps.message: Execute: adb shell "echo '---find recipes---'; find /sdcard /storage/emulated/0 -type f -iname 'recipes.txt' 2>/dev/null; echo '---preview recipes---'; f=$(find /sdcard /storage/emulated/0 -type f -iname 'recipes.txt' 2>/dev/null | head -n 1); [ -n \"$f\" ] && { echo FILE:$f; sed -n '1,120p' \"$f\"; } || echo 'NO_FILE'; echo '---run-as broccoli---'; run-as com.flauschcode.broccoli sh -c 'pwd; ls -la; ls -la databases 2>/dev/null; ls -la files 2>/dev/null; ls -la shared_prefs 2>/dev/null' ; echo '---run-as markor---'; run-as net.gsantner.markor sh -c 'pwd; ls -la; ls -la files 2>/dev/null; ls -la databases 2>/dev/null'"
